facts.fact: The Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, with the UN Economic Commission for Africa and GIZ, held a stakeholder workshop in Brazzaville on 8-9 June 2026 with 60 participants to help draft the National Data Governance Strategy, after an assessment mission of 2-6 June consulting 21 institutions from government, regulators, academia, the private sector, civil society and development partners.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance des données

note: One held consultation on the draft national data governance strategy; no published report of comments or answer, no legal requirement or standing body stated.
